title: Chapter 362 Supreme Law
content:
Chapter 362 Supreme Law

That's it? !

Countless creatures in the Chaos Realm looked up at the sky in horror.

I saw three faint figures covering the sky and the sun constantly attacking the outer barriers of the Chaos Realm.

The supreme law of the Chaos Realm obviously noticed the three uninvited guests. The terrifying thunder tribulation kept bombarding the three people, trying to prevent the three people from entering the world.

But whether it was the repulsion of the Chaos Realm or the turbulent void outside the sky, the three of them ignored it and wanted to penetrate the Chaos Realm.

The power in his hand was heading towards the outer barriers of the Chaos Realm like a desperate attempt.

The roars came into the ears of sentient beings, and they were endless.

At this moment, the human race in the Chaos Realm was already in tears.

Those three were the heroes of their human race several times ago.

And these three people have long been unfathomable and have left the Chaos Realm for a long time.

Now, Lu Daosheng activated the blood summon, and these three people obviously received the news and rushed back to the Chaos Realm to save the human race regardless of everything.

"Who says that the human race has no supreme?"

A white-haired senior of the human race stood in front of everyone, his turbid eyes were covered with tears, and he couldn't help but sigh.

Above the sky.

Although the three figures were slow, they were really entering the Chaos Realm bit by bit.

The people couldn't hide their excitement.

They are truly countless heroes.

The other tribes in the Chaos Realm looked at the three figures outside the sky and were silent.

They did not believe that the other party could be so strong that they ignored the supreme laws of the Chaos Realm and forced into it.

But as they watched the other party move constantly, they hesitated again.

It seems that it is really OK.

And at this moment, a sound of doubt sounded.

"No, why didn't this senior stop this time entering the Chaos Realm?"

The speaker is a human master.

As soon as these words came out, everyone immediately reacted.

Yes, why is this senior not stopped?

Could it be that I have walked through the back door?

When the clans heard this, they all sneered in their hearts. Why is it? It must be because the other party is not strong.

wrong!

If Lu Daosheng is not strong enough, how could he break the outer barriers of the Chaos Realm with one punch?

Could it be? !

In an instant, a terrifying idea appeared in the minds of the races and then it couldn't be gone.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already smiled strangely.

"Why, why else? If I want to come in, will this supreme law dare to say no? "

Arrogant, how arrogant this is!

Lu Daosheng's short words made countless creatures in the Chaos Realm angry but not speak out.

This man dared to despise the supreme law.

The Supreme Law, the word Supreme, has already explained everything.

Throughout history, they have never seen anyone so disrespectful to the Supreme Law.

But Lu Daosheng is such an exception.

Lu Daosheng didn't need to respect this supreme law. He was not a native creature in the Chaos Realm, nor did he ascend to the sky by any means.

He relied on his own fist to hit in.

No one in this world can receive his respect.

The sentient beings thought that Lu Daosheng's arrogant words would bring punishment from the Supreme Law, or even kill them.

But time passed minute by minute, but Lu Daosheng had nothing to do.

"What's going on?"

"Can't it be that the Supreme Law is so humiliated by him?"

"Hmph, I think the Supreme Law is now busy stopping the three powerful humans outside the sky and have no time to take action."

As long as the three human powerhouses are dealt with, Lu Daosheng will inevitably be erased by the Supreme Law.

They thought so.

But Lu Daosheng was slowly heading towards the sky at this moment.

"Senior, be careful, the supreme law,

When a human master saw Lu Daosheng walking there, he quickly reminded him, but before he finished speaking, he was stunned.

Not only him, but all other creatures are the same.

It was just because the overwhelming terrifying thunder tribulation slowly dissipated because Lu Daosheng gradually approached.

Outside the sky.

The three human strong men were slightly stunned, and the pressure suddenly disappeared.

The three of them did not hesitate and quickly tried to forcefully break through the barriers outside the boundary.

But at this time, a gap was automatically cracked for the three of them to enter.

"Um?"

Looking at the Chaos Realm that could be entered in one step, the three of them were hesitant.

The three of them looked at each other, with a look of surprise and suspicion in their eyes.

"what to do?"

"What else can I do? Come in."

"Haha, then okay, I'll start."

Immediately, three men entered in one after another.

As soon as you enter the Chaos Realm, you will be a man with a simple aura and a beautiful tree.

And Lu Daosheng also saw the faces of the three of them.

Two men and one woman, the realm is above the Chaos Realm. No wonder they were stopped by the Chaos Realm.

If these three people are allowed to enter, the Chaos Realm will inevitably suffer irreversible trauma.

The three of them naturally understood this principle, but they could no longer control so much.

My mother's family is about to be destroyed, who cares about this?

"Are you the human leader of the Chaos Realm now?"

Among the three, a woman with a ponytail standing upright and holding a golden spear asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

Seeing Lu Daosheng shaking his head, the three of them frowned unconsciously.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said, "I have just come to this world and see that the human race is in trouble. How can I not save you when I am a human race?"

"That blood call was activated by me."

Lu Daosheng's words shocked the three of them.

There are two information.

One is Lu Daosheng, who has just come to this world.

That means that the opponent's strength is definitely not inferior to them, otherwise the external barriers of the Chaos Realm would not be able to be broken.

As for Lu Daosheng ascended through some means, it is even more impossible.

To their point, they can recognize whether the other party is a strong person at a glance.

The second one was Lu Daosheng who activated the blood summon.

What does that mean? Lu Daosheng is definitely not an ordinary person and is very likely to be a descendant of the Human Emperor lineage.

The Blood Summoning has long been lost, and it can still be used now, except for the successor of the Human Emperor, they cannot think of a second possibility.

"The human race is here forever."

"Human race, martial arts."

"Huo Xingzhi."

The three of them bowed to Lu Daosheng with a slightly respectful look.

Lu Daosheng also nodded in response.

"Human race, Lu Daosheng."

This is also the first time Lu Daosheng has appeared as a human race.

In the past, he always called himself the lord of the Huangcheng City.

"Friend, don't you know the barrier outside the world, but did you help me and the other three break it?"

Among the three, the short-haired man named Wushang asked with a smile.

The three of them looked at Lu Daosheng.

As creatures in the Chaos Realm, they naturally knew this supreme law.

If it weren't for the safety of the human race this time, they wouldn't have provoked this supreme law.

But this time, the Supreme Law was abnormal. Not only did it recover the thunder tribulation, it also took the initiative to open the door.

I don’t know, but I thought it was to let them go home to visit their relatives.
